purpose: Original evidence-informed stylized fossil/environment prop; candidate only

criteria.description: Validate shipped static GLB, official format validation, scale/origin, exact geometry/texture budgets and provenance.
Inspect every frozen diagnostic and turntable frame against references; silhouette, construction, proportions and materials must meet the brief.
Compare every diagnostic anatomical/botanical/geological feature with cited sources and label reconstruction uncertainty.
Verify the frozen brief, complete deliverables and all explicit constraints.
Parse this exact GLB with the pinned target loader and record bounds, materials and errors.
Render this exact GLB in the target graphics runtime; inspect frames and capture renderer/device and measured work.
Render the intended composed scene including this exact GLB; inspect scale/contact/material consistency and measure scene work.

coverage_justification: Explicit static-stylized-v1 fixed eight views, zero turntable per batch dispatch
claim_scope: One coherent scooped wind-eroded basin with a low downwind sediment rim. The depression and asymmetrical rim must be real volume, readable in clay and silhouette, not a painted hollow or a generic impact crater. Preserve the original generic geological-form scope without a named locality, age or measured dimensions.
dimension_status: Artistic nominal overall target; measured bounds recorded separately after build, not specimen measurement
recognition_features: Low upwind entrance and quiet basin floor
concept_decisions: Wind from -Y to +Y; downwind rim only broad +Y end, no circular crater crest. Closed solid cutaway base; dimensions artistic landscape module, no real-site scale claim.
style: Original restrained palette-only refined low-poly; broad quiet planes and diagnostic relief
intended_use: Small supporting teaching prop, 256–512px diagnostic inspection

packaging_adapter.note: Post-build packaging adapter v002 explicitly declares actual source/generator/config paths and hashes. Production lifecycle profile and static-stylized-v1 validation profile are distinct. Original frozen premodel brief/config and adapter v001 retained unchanged; no design geometry/view/stage/budget scope changes. This is not a claim of pre-model artifact hashes.
